_comment: Message library for information warfare. Variables: {sender.name}, {target.name}, {plaza.name}, {road.name}, {faction.name}, {rival_faction.name}, {number}.

messages.text: {plaza.name} has an owner. Anyone who works here without permission answers to {sender.name}.
New management in {plaza.name}. Merchants: nothing changes if you pay on time. — {sender.name}
{target.name} sells information to the government. Ask yourselves who gets arrested and who never does.
{target.name}'s people are the ones robbing and killing civilians. We only deal with those who owe.
To the halcones of {plaza.name} who took money from {rival_faction.name}: we know who you are. Last warning.
{target.name}: stay in your hills. Come down to {plaza.name} and you will not go back up.
{target.name} changed sides once. Whoever trusts him will learn what he is worth.
Families of {plaza.name}: go about your lives. This is not your war. — {sender.name}
Cobro de piso in {plaza.name} is lowered starting today. We take care of those who take care of us.
The soldiers who came to {plaza.name} work for {target.name}. Everyone saw whose houses they skipped.
{sender.name} speaks to the men of {faction.name}: the war will be won by those who stay loyal.
{sender.name}, surrounded by armed men, names {target.name} and gives him a week to leave Sinaloa.
{sender.name} denies any part in the attack in {plaza.name} and blames {rival_faction.name}.
A video shows a column of armored trucks with {faction.name} markings rolling through {plaza.name}.
Men claiming to be {target.name}'s people confess on camera that their boss abandoned them.
{sender.name} calls on both sides to leave the families of Culiacán out of it.
{faction.name} took {plaza.name} last night. The other side ran.
{target.name} has fled Sinaloa. His men are asking who pays them now.
{rival_faction.name} can't make payroll. Their halcones are selling out for nothing.
Twelve of {target.name}'s men fell on the road to {plaza.name}. We lost none.
{target.name} has sold his plaza to outsiders from Jalisco. Sinaloa belongs to Sinaloans.
The army does the dirty work for {rival_faction.name}. Look at which plazas they never raid.
Sources confirm {target.name} was wounded in {plaza.name} and cannot walk.
{faction.name} pays on time, every Sunday. Good men are welcome.
El corrido de {sender.name}
La troca negra de {plaza.name}
Siete de la sierra
El que nunca dormía
La emboscada del kilómetro {number}
Leal hasta el final
De {plaza.name} para el mundo
El fantasma de la brecha
A convoy of {sender.name}'s men will cross {road.name} tonight.
{plaza.name} is barely guarded. Most of the garrison left for Culiacán.
{sender.name}'s biggest lab is hidden outside {plaza.name}.
{target.name} has been meeting with {rival_faction.name}'s people in secret.
{target.name} is giving names to the federales in exchange for his brother's release.
{sender.name}'s payroll moves every Saturday on {road.name}, one car, two men.
{sender.name} is staying at a ranch outside {plaza.name} with only a few guards.
{target.name} has promised a route to the outsiders from Jalisco.
